population.kidComparison: About 21.9 million people live in Zambia—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Inland terrain bordered by neighboring countries.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Zambia
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Zambia.

exploration.didYouKnow: Zambia is located in Eastern Africa and its capital city is Lusaka.
